Product Description

Gildan’s Adult Softstyle Cotton Tee G64000 has the perfect combination of softness and durability to ensure it stands the test of time. Made of 100% ring spun cotton with a modern classic cut, it’s perfect for lounging on the couch or going to a movie. Its soft smooth fabric is perfect for screen printing, embroidery, DTG, bleaching and tie dyeing.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Soft, Comfortable Shirt That Fits Great
    Reviewed in the United States on July 11, 2026
    Size: LargeColor: Heather RedNumber of Items: 2
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I’ve worn a lot of basic T-shirts over the years, and this one stands out for its comfort. The fabric is soft right out of the package, and it’s lightweight without feeling too thin. It’s comfortable enough to wear all day, whether you’re relaxing at home, running errands, or layering it under a sweatshirt or jacket.

    The fit was true to size, and it has a nice shape without being too tight or too loose. After washing, it held up well with minimal shrinkage, and the material stayed soft. The stitching also seems solid, and the shirt has maintained its shape after multiple washes.

    Overall, this is a great everyday T-shirt at a reasonable price. It’s comfortable, well made, and exactly what I look for in a basic cotton tee. I’d definitely buy more in other colors.

    Firstly, I think it’s important to note just how comfortable these shirts are. The material is quite soft, and the material feels thick enough to feel as if it’s higher quality than the price would suggest. The color variety you can buy these in gives you a lot of choices for styling, and the price point makes it plausible to buy multiple different colors. My only wish for this is that you could buy different colors in pairs, but this doesn’t really detract from the fact that you still receive two extremely comfy shirts that are great for lounging or day-to-day activities. I haven’t seen these shirts shrink much at all during the wash either, so I do think they’ll stand the test of time for at least a couple years. One other quick note, these shirts have a great combination of being comfortably loose around the abdomen and lower torso area, but slightly tighter and smaller at the arms, so you won’t have much in the way of flapping sleeves if that’s a pet peeve. Overall, very respectable quality for the price, I think it’s quite hard to beat and definitely worth getting a couple of pairs for at-home wear at the very least.

Product Description

Gildan’s Adult Softstyle Cotton Tee G64000 has the perfect combination of softness and durability to ensure it stands the test of time. Made of 100% ring spun cotton with a modern classic cut, it’s perfect for lounging on the couch or going to a movie. Its soft smooth fabric is perfect for screen printing, embroidery, DTG, bleaching and tie dyeing.
